name: Split cents
spec:
Implement SplitCents(total, recipients int) ([]int, error).

Split a non-negative number of cents among a positive number of recipients. Return a slice whose length is exactly recipients. Every recipient gets total / recipients cents, and the remaining total % recipients cents go one at a time to the earliest recipients (lower index).

For total < 0 or recipients <= 0, return a nil slice and a non-nil error. Do not panic.
